title: T10 Web: compare sessions and export
description: Depends on T8 and T9. Files: new web/components/CostCompare.tsx, web/lib/api.ts. Pick two or more channels or turns, show totals and normalized metrics (cost per turn, per tool call, per sub-agent, cached ratio, rounds per turn), download CSV or NDJSON. Acceptance: plan scenarios 22 and 23 reachable from the UI; web tests green.
right_now_summary: The team is building a web view to compare sessions and export normalized cost metrics.
